title: Manual and automated accessibility checks
learningObjectives: Explain manual and automated accessibility checks and apply it to accessible, reliable web development.

understand.concept: Automated accessibility tools can identify issues such as missing labels, invalid ARIA, and some contrast problems. Manual checks are still needed for keyboard operation, focus order, screen-reader clarity, zoom, captions, and task completion. Accessibility testing should be repeated during development.
understand.whyItMatters: No single tool can prove a page is accessible. Combining automated scans with manual testing catches a broader range of barriers.
understand.analogy: Automated checks are a checklist assistant; manual testing is using the product in the ways real people need.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; web protocols, browser behaviour, and accessibility requirements follow formal standards and platform implementations.

explain.narrative: The list is a practical test set. A real audit should record the page, browser, assistive technology, issue, severity, and reproduction steps.

practise.guidedTask: Run an automated scan and then complete a keyboard-only and screen-reader review. Record at least one issue each method finds.
practise.independentTask: Apply the concept to a small web page. Record the expected behaviour, how you tested it, and any limitations or fallbacks.
hints: Use browser developer tools to inspect actual behaviour.
Test with keyboard and different viewport sizes.
Keep core content available when enhancements are unsupported.

options: No, manual testing is also required
questions.answer: No, manual testing is also required
questions.explanation: Automated tools detect only a subset of accessibility barriers.

options: Test actual browser behaviour and provide accessible fallbacks
Assume the browser always behaves exactly as expected
questions.answer: Test actual browser behaviour and provide accessible fallbacks
questions.explanation: Reliable web work combines standards knowledge with real testing and inclusive fallbacks.
